decision_zh: 可以做 H3 专用的一到两条纯文本入口，但不能仅删除固定 conditioning SHA 断言后就开放任意长度。先补真实 tokenizer 的 CPU-only 前置长度门；本轮只保留已验证 Trim8 配方和阶段释放，不合并异步/缓存/headroom 新变量。

input_contract_proposal.format: Small UTF-8 local JSON, strict unique keys; prompts array of 1 or 2 strings. No user graph, URLs, image/audio paths, node names, output path or model settings.
input_contract_proposal.bounds_proposed_not_yet_frozen: File <=16 KiB; each prompt nonblank UTF-8 <=4096 bytes; reject NUL, malformed Unicode and embedding: directives. Byte limit is parser bound, NOT token/capacity guarantee.
input_contract_proposal.preservation: No text truncation/rewrite. Snapshot exact input and SHA locally; prompt index supplies safe output ID, never prompt text as filename or command.
input_contract_proposal.token_limit_reason: The currently successful real one-service requests have 41/49 tokens; 64 would be a separate extension, not already proven.
input_contract_proposal.cpu_preflight: Use frozen installed MiniMaxH3Tokenizer only, no model/CLIP weight construction, under explicit --cpu/CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, offline tokenizer files, E cache/temp. Count the sole qwen3vl_32b token batch; require 1<=T<=49 and all token entries integer/weight1. Record tokenizer source/data hashes and actual token-ID digest. Verify current fixed 41/49 examples as equivalence anchors first. Native runtime imports and resource envelope of this tiny CPU helper still need one bounded check; not executed in this design.

minimal_changes.part: Input snapshot and Stage A builder
minimal_changes.change: Deep-copy the already frozen Stage A template. Permit only node104 prompt literal and SaveConditioning output prefix derived from request index. Freeze job JSON and generated graph hashes before service. Both 1 and 2 prompt jobs use same four model assets/receipts and source identity.

Compute N from input. Requests 1..2N alternating TE/video, /free exactly 2N-1 between requests, one known prompt ID and POST attempt per request. Preserve first full admission and every warm-admission remaining-private-growth check. Keep total timeout/output/WS/history budgets unchanged.

Replace CASES fixed-token lookup with CPU-preflight expected T. Keep exact pure-text tensor set, options {}, F32[1,T,5120], I64[T] all1, finite raw bits, nonzero condition, 512 KiB chunking, bounded headers, contiguous offsets and no trailing payload. Do not loosen to pooled/multimodal options.

Compute whole output SHA/stat identity under monitor, create unique samefile hardlink alias, revalidate whole SHA/header/stat immediately before actual B POST. New-prompt receipt records real prompt/graph/tokenizer/T/output identities. Remove requirement to equal old 41/49 reference ONLY for new arbitrary prompt mode; explicit frozen-case comparison mode retains exact reference requirement. New prompts report reference_equivalence=not_applicable, never synthetic reference or old receipt.

Current load_stage_b_manifest hard-pins old toycar conditioning metadata as a graph-template anchor. Keep immutable graph assets/recipe but label it template provenance; bind actual condition from previous TE. Do not report that anchor as a reference for new text.

Preserve exact Trim8 geometry/steps/seed and nativegraph class/input checks. Adapt aggregate to N videos, each with a genuinely corresponding actual receipt/artifact and full existing 73-frame+audio validator. Keep cleanup first and require owned workers terminal before media. No silent continuation on an over-budget/failed TE.
